__HIDDENCAT__
This hidden maintenance category collects pages with a <code><nowiki>{{StanceTooltip}}</nowiki></code> whose <code>stablekey</code> matches no stance in the game data. Often a game update renamed or removed the stance.

To fix a page, give the template the current key of the stance, or remove the template. See [[Erenshor Wiki:Game Data#Maintenance categories]].
